component.name: FileCat
component.summary: Multi-panel file manager with built-in viewers and recovery

description.p: FileCat is a keyboard-first file manager for local folders, removable storage, archives and remote servers. Arrange dockable panels and tabs around the task, save named workspaces and keep the source and destination visible when moving or copying files.

Built-in viewers open text, hex, images, PDF, HTML and Markdown. Structured inspectors show PE, ELF, Mach-O and APK/AAB files, plus image, audio and video metadata, without executing or playing the files. Search file names and contents, find duplicates, compare folders and batch-rename files.
Scan NTFS, FAT and exFAT disks or disk images for deleted files, preview recovery candidates and copy them to another drive. Recovery results show when file contents are incomplete or unavailable.
